options.name: aaadloglevel
options.description: AAAD log level, which specifies the types of AAAD events to log in nsvpn.log. Available values function as follows: * C(EMERGENCY) - Events that indicate an immediate crisis on the server. * C(ALERT) - Events that might require action. * C(CRITICAL) - Events that indicate an imminent server crisis. * C(ERROR) - Events that indicate some type of error. * C(WARNING) - Events that require action in the near future. * C(NOTICE) - Events that the administrator should know about. * C(INFORMATIONAL) -

options.name: aaadnatip
options.description: Source IP address to use for traffic that is sent to the authentication server.

options.name: aaasessionloglevel
options.description: Audit log level, which specifies the types of events to log for cli executed commands. Available values function as follows: * C(EMERGENCY) - Events that indicate an immediate crisis on the server. * C(ALERT) - Events that might require action. * C(CRITICAL) - Events that indicate an imminent server crisis. * C(ERROR) - Events that indicate some type of error. * C(WARNING) - Events that require action in the near future. * C(NOTICE) - Events that the administrator should know about. * C(INFORMAT

options.name: api_path
options.description: Base NITRO API path. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: apitokencache
options.description: Option to enable/disable API cache feature.

options.name: defaultauthtype
options.description: The default authentication server type.

options.name: defaultcspheader
options.description: Parameter to enable/disable default CSP header

options.name: dynaddr
options.description: Set by the DHCP client when the IP address was fetched dynamically.

options.name: enableenhancedauthfeedback
options.description: Enhanced auth feedback provides more information to the end user about the reason for an authentication failure.  The default value is set to C(NO).

options.name: enablesessionstickiness
options.description: Enables/Disables stickiness to authentication servers

options.name: enablestaticpagecaching
options.description: The default state of VPN Static Page caching. Static Page caching is enabled by default.

options.name: enhancedepa
options.description: Parameter to enable/disable EPA v2 functionality

options.name: failedlogintimeout
options.description: Number of minutes an account will be locked if user exceeds maximum permissible attempts

options.name: ftmode
options.description: First time user mode determines which configuration options are shown by default when logging in to the GUI. This setting is controlled by the GUI.

options.name: httponlycookie
options.description: Parameter to set/reset HttpOnly Flag for NSC_AAAC/NSC_TMAS cookies in nfactor

options.name: loginencryption
options.description: Parameter to encrypt login information for nFactor flow

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_id
options.description: The ID of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_ip
options.description: The IP of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_name
options.description: The name of the managed NetScaler instance to which NetScaler Console has to configure as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_password
options.description: The password of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: managed_netscaler_instance_username
options.description: The username of the managed NetScaler instance. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call In Settings > Administration > System Configurations > Basic Settings, if you select Prompt Credentials for Instance Login, ensure to configure username and password of a managed instance.

options.name: maxaaausers
options.description: Maximum number of concurrent users allowed to log on to VPN simultaneously.

options.name: maxkbquestions
options.description: This will set maximum number of Questions to be asked for KB Validation. Default value is 2, Max Value is 6

options.name: maxloginattempts
options.description: Maximum Number of login Attempts

options.name: maxsamldeflatesize
options.description: This will set the maximum deflate size in case of SAML Redirect binding.

options.name: netscaler_console_as_proxy_server
options.description: The IP address of the NetScaler ADC appliance acting as a proxy server. Define only in case of an ADM service proxy call

options.name: nitro_auth_token
options.description: The authentication token provided by a login operation.

options.name: nitro_pass
options.description: The password with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nitro_protocol
options.description: Which protocol to use when accessing the nitro API objects.

options.name: nitro_user
options.description: The username with which to authenticate to the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: nsip
options.description: The ip address of the NetScaler ADC appliance where the nitro API calls will be made. The port can be specified with the colon (:). E.g. 192.168.1.1:555.

options.name: persistentloginattempts
options.description: Persistent storage of unsuccessful user login attempts

options.name: pwdexpirynotificationdays
options.description: This will set the threshold time in days for password expiry notification. Default value is 0, which means no notification is sent

options.name: remove_non_updatable_params
options.description: When given yes, the module will remove any parameters that are not updatable in the resource. If no, the module will return error if any non-updatable parameters are provided.

options.name: samesite
options.description: SameSite attribute value for Cookies generated in AAATM context. This attribute value will be appended only for the cookies which are specified in the builtin patset ns_cookies_samesite

options.name: save_config
options.description: If C(true) the module will save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it makes any changes. The module will not save the configuration on the NetScaler ADC node if it made no changes.

options.name: securityinsights
options.description: On enabling this option, the Citrix ADC will send the security insight records to the configured collectors when request comes to Authentication endpoint. * If cs vserver is frontend with Authentication vserver as target for cs action, then record is sent using Authentication vserver name. * If vpn/lb/cs vserver are configured with Authentication ON, then then record is sent using vpn/lb/cs vserver name accordingly. * If authentication vserver is frontend, then record is sent using Authenticatio

options.name: state
options.description: The state of the resource being configured by the module on the NetScaler ADC node. When C(present), the resource will be added/updated configured according to the module's parameters. When C(unset), the resource will be unset on the NetScaler ADC node.

options.name: tokenintrospectioninterval
options.description: Frequency at which a token must be verified at the Authorization Server (AS) despite being found in cache.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: If C(false), SSL certificates will not be validated. This should only be used on personally controlled sites using self-signed certificates.

options.name: wafprotection
options.description: Entities for which WAF Protection need to be applied. Available settings function as follows: * C(DEFAULT) - C(AUTH), C(VPN) and C(PORTAL) Protections are enabled. This is the default value for wafProtection * C(AUTH) - Endpoints used for Authentication applicable for both AAATM, IDP, GATEWAY use cases. * C(VPN) - Endpoints used for Gateway use cases. * C(PORTAL) - Endpoints related to web portal. * C(DISABLED) - No Endpoint WAF protection. Currently supported only in default partition
